name: Testimonial Wall
description: Drifting columns of testimonial cards at different speeds that ease to a stop under the pointer, with spotlight borders, initials avatars and verified marks.

props.name: testimonials
props.description: { quote, name, role, company, verified? }. Wrap one phrase of the quote in **…** to set it at full strength. Dealt round-robin into columns.

props.name: height
props.description: Wall height in px at two or three columns; one column uses at most 600px.

props.name: speeds
props.description: Drift speed per column in px/s. Columns alternate direction.

props.name: pauseControl
props.description: Shows a small pause / play button in the corner.
